# platform.SetTenantBudgetInput

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Staff overrides (or clears the override of) an organization's monthly budget caps.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `platform.SetTenantBudgetInput` |
| Kind | `command` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `platform` |

## Fields
